root_cause: Connector registry used eager require() at module load time. All 5 connector requires executed synchronously on startup. Any connector file error (missing dep, syntax, path) caused enrichment-queue.js to throw at load, which caused server.js (which eagerly requires enrichment-queue.js) to crash before binding to PORT.
fix_applied: Rolled back to inline fetchOwnerData() with no external connector imports. Philly OPA fetch kept inline with axios. Other cities return null safely.
prevention_rule: NEVER use eager require() for optional/external modules in files that server.js loads at startup. Always use lazy require() inside function bodies OR wrap in try/catch factory. Deploy ONE connector at a time and verify health after each.
